local data={
	-----Aurylene Crystal-----
	["Aurylene Crystal"]={name="Aurylene Crystal", tier=5, use="Acquired by converting precipitation nodules brought out from the Valley's Aberrants. Can be submitted to complete or refresh commissions.", desc="A glimmering Aurylene Crystal created through special means. It offers unique research values.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	-----Operation Metrics-----
	["Operation Metrics"]={name="Operation Metrics", tier=5, use="Acquired by bringing out precipitation nodules from the Valley's Aberrants or by completing certain commissions. Earn enough Operation Metrics to claim rewards.", desc="Every number in this logbook represents our deeper understanding of this unknown realm.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	-----Aurylene Crystal Nodules-----
	["Malformed Nodule [S]"]={name="Malformed Nodule [S]", image="Malformed Nodule (S)", link="Malformed Nodule (S)", tier=1, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can give birth to realistic projections of the past.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Malformed Nodule [M]"]={name="Malformed Nodule [M]", image="Malformed Nodule (M)", link="Malformed Nodule (M)", tier=1, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can give birth to exaggerated imaginations never thought of before.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Malformed Nodule [L]"]={name="Malformed Nodule [L]", image="Malformed Nodule (L)", link="Malformed Nodule (L)", tier=2, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can also give birth to wild, twisted, yet superficial fantasies.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Rough Nodule [S]"]={name="Rough Nodule [S]", image="Rough Nodule (S)", link="Rough Nodule (S)", tier=1, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation imbued with life, hope, and a sprinkle of love... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Rough Nodule [M]"]={name="Rough Nodule [M]", image="Rough Nodule (M)", link="Rough Nodule (M)", tier=2, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation imbued with growth, power, and a dash of confusion... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Rough Nodule [L]"]={name="Rough Nodule [L]", image="Rough Nodule (L)", link="Rough Nodule (L)", tier=3, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation imbued with depletion, despair, and a touch of death... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Common Nodule [S]"]={name="Common Nodule [S]", image="Common Nodule (S)", link="Common Nodule (S)", tier=1, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation. \"The first victors and survivors took the path, as well as the entire civilization, upon themselves.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Enemies"},
	["Common Nodule [M]"]={name="Common Nodule [M]", image="Common Nodule (M)", link="Common Nodule (M)", tier=2, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation. \"The cold glance bears the weight to crush everything in sight.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Enemies"},
	["Common Nodule [L]"]={name="Common Nodule [L]", image="Common Nodule (L)", link="Common Nodule (L)", tier=4, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation. \"Though they faced the daunting cliffs, humanity succeeded in chiseling out a stony alcove for the nurturing of life.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Enemies"},
	["Fine Nodule [S]"]={name="Fine Nodule [S]", image="Fine Nodule (S)", link="Fine Nodule (S)", tier=2, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation. \"The children left home but became lost in the night. Thus they never stopped crying.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Enemies"},
	["Fine Nodule [M]"]={name="Fine Nodule [M]", image="Fine Nodule (M)", link="Fine Nodule (M)", tier=3, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation. \"It ended when they touched their first tool and struck their first burst of sparks.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Enemies"},
	["Fine Nodule [L]"]={name="Fine Nodule [L]", image="Fine Nodule (L)", link="Fine Nodule (L)", tier=4, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation. \"Tunnel through the mountains! Ignite yourselves and leave the long night behind.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Enemies"},
	["Rare Nodule [S]"]={name="Rare Nodule [S]", image="Rare Nodule (S)", link="Rare Nodule (S)", tier=3, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation. \"And that was how steel and concrete sprouted from the ground. They become the framework of the land, the skeleton of Civilization.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Enemies"},
	["Rare Nodule [M]"]={name="Rare Nodule [M]", image="Rare Nodule (M)", link="Rare Nodule (M)", tier=4, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation. \"Blood and fresh grew forth to mend the gashes of the land.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Enemies"},
	["Rare Nodule [L]"]={name="Rare Nodule [L]", image="Rare Nodule (L)", link="Rare Nodule (L)", tier=5, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation. \"When the first heartbeat was heard, the answer was well within reach.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Enemies"},
	["Precious Nodule [S]"]={name="Precious Nodule [S]", image="Precious Nodule (S)", link="Precious Nodule (S)", tier=3, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation. \"The answer was so close, just one jump away.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Leap.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Enemies"},
	["Precious Nodule [M]"]={name="Precious Nodule [M]", image="Precious Nodule (M)", link="Precious Nodule (M)", tier=4, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation. \"Make the giant leap and become the stars themselves.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Leap.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Enemies"},
	["Precious Nodule [L]"]={name="Precious Nodule [L]", image="Precious Nodule (L)", link="Precious Nodule (L)", tier=5, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation. \"Eons of barrenness burned to lead the uplifted ones forward.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Leap.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Enemies"},
	["Sparkling Nodule [S]"]={name="Sparkling Nodule [S]", image="Sparkling Nodule (S)", link="Sparkling Nodule (S)", tier=4, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A small and dense crystal formation. \"The aberrants are derived from entities that rejected life.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Enemies"},
	["Sparkling Nodule [M]"]={name="Sparkling Nodule [M]", image="Sparkling Nodule (M)", link="Sparkling Nodule (M)", tier=5, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A sizable and dense crystal formation. \"Within the aberrants, a future yet realized gives birth to an abominable gall.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Enemies"},
	["Sparkling Nodule [L]"]={name="Sparkling Nodule [L]", image="Sparkling Nodule (L)", link="Sparkling Nodule (L)", tier=5, use="Acquired by shattering precipitation crystals and gathering the pieces, or by looting defeated enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Can be converted into Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A large and dense crystal formation. \"Here is the hazefyre that chokes the path. The malignance consuming Civilization has continued to spread.\" It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gathering: Valley's Aberrants, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Enemies"},
	-----Precipitation Manifest-----
	["Mask Fragment"]={name="Mask Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 1 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. The scars of combat that cover the fragment seem to be moving.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Twisted Mask Fragment"]={name="Twisted Mask Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 1 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. Upon closer inspection, the scars of combat that cover the fragment would suddenly turn blurry.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Enemies"},
	["Detonation Unit Fragment"]={name="Detonation Unit Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 1 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This is a casing fragment of a lost detonation unit. A gentle tap allows one to feel the explosive energy contained within.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Bosses"},
	["Rust Fragment"]={name="Rust Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 2 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It still gives off strange pulses of energy when held.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Enemies"},
	["Dark Rust Fragment"]={name="Dark Rust Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 2 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It is covered by a black substance that constantly twitches and changes its location.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Enemies"},
	["Amberite Fragment"]={name="Amberite Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 2 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This sample resembles an amber-colored rock and was taken from the remains of an Effigy (Aggelos). Subjecting the sample to external impact causes the fragment to temporarily collapse into an amber-colored vortex before reverting to its original form.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Bosses"},
	["Crystal-Embedded Fragment"]={name="Crystal-Embedded Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 3 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism and has bits of Originium crystals, also shed by the said organism, attached to it. Unlike other plant matter, the sample seems hard enough to pierce armor.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Enemies"},
	["Tainted Crystal-Embedded Fragment"]={name="Tainted Crystal-Embedded Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 3 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism. In addition to bits of Originium crystal attachments, the sample is coated with a Blighted material that should not be there in the first place.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Enemies"},
	["Axe Armor Fragment"]={name="Axe Armor Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 3 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This sharp and sturdy horn fragment was dropped off the back of an Axe Armorbeast. Any rock that comes into contact with the fragment would be pulverized to gravel.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Bosses"},
	["Refractorite Fragment"]={name="Refractorite Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 3 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was taken from the remains of a Sentinel (Aggelos). Though covered by what seems to be scorch marks, no artificial temperature is hot enough to melt the fragment.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Bosses"},
	["Tubular Fragment"]={name="Tubular Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 4 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. Analysis reveals that the fragment exhibits unusually high energy density.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Enemies"},
	["Tough Tubular Fragment"]={name="Tough Tubular Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 4 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. In addition to its unusually high energy density, the fragment also exhibits flickers of hazefyre that can be seen with the unaided eye.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Enemies"},
	["Scorching Hot Bolt Fragment"]={name="Scorching Hot Bolt Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 4 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was part of a massive ballista bolt. When a piece of paper is gently brushed against its edges, it would be shredded in an instant before being burned to ashes.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Bosses"},
	["Densolite Fragment"]={name="Densolite Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 5 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though it appears dense and heavy, it is actually surprisingly light.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Enemies"},
	["Energized Densolite Fragment"]={name="Energized Densolite Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 5 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though exceptionally hard, it occasionally twists itself into spiral.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Enemies"},
	["Unbreachable Crystal Fragment"]={name="Unbreachable Crystal Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 5 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was shed by a smooth, crystalline entity. No other material or tool could leave a mark on the sample. In fact, none of the attempts even made a sound.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Bosses"},
	["Tactical Equipment Fragment"]={name="Tactical Equipment Fragment", tier=4, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 6 enemies. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was excised from the combat wraps often used by Landbreakers. It exhibits Æther energy levels that exceed the max readings of most instruments, yet somehow retains its original form.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Enemies"},
	["Aberrant Hazefyre Fragment"]={name="Aberrant Hazefyre Fragment", tier=5, use="Looted from Aberrant Zone 6 bosses. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A material sample with many rare properties. A fragment that fell off an ever-rising orb of hazefyre. Those who approach it might hear the surging cries of a great crowd. Upon reaching the zenith, a warrior's path of carnage ceases abruptly.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Bosses"},
	["Classified: Aggelos Rotreed"]={name="Classified: Aggelos Rotreed", image="Classified Aggelos Rotreed", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about a particular plant. It is native to the Valley's Aberrants and common in areas with Aggelos remains in the Protocol Space. This seems to suggest that the plant grew on the remains themselves.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Package"},
	["Classified: Underground Boxer"]={name="Classified: Underground Boxer", image="Classified Underground Boxer", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about an underground boxer. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it. \"Fought worthier opponents in the underground arenas of the Asphalt Roundabout...\" it boasted.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Bigfowl"]={name="Gold Statuette: Bigfowl", image="Gold Statuette Bigfowl", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette that resembles Andre. Wait... Is it secretly getting ... bigger?", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Andre"]={name="Gold Statuette: Andre", image="Gold Statuette Andre", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Andre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. His terrified looks are extremely well done. Someone even added this sentimental comment: \"This would be perfect if someone places a gold Landbreaker axe right in front of it.\"", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Bread"]={name="Specimen: Bread", image="Specimen Bread", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A small piece of bread sealed in a jar. This specimen weighs extremely heavy, as though some twisted aberrant forged the workers' steel-like will into a bread-like image.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Toolkit"]={name="Specimen: Toolkit", image="Specimen Toolkit", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 white quality auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A set of tools sealed in a jar. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it: \"...go bandit-smashing with my hammer...\" or \"...these pipefaced rascals...\"", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 White Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: Meat-Packing Plant"]={name="Classified: Meat-Packing Plant", image="Classified Meat-Packing Plant", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about a meat-packing plant. In some twisted aberrant, the meat-packing plant became a terrible lair that mass produces Aggeloi.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Package"},
	["Classified: Worker Dorms"]={name="Classified: Worker Dorms", image="Classified Worker Dorms", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the origins and construction of the Worker Dorms. From the very first shop, the very first clinic, and finally to all sorts of bread baked by Roman, these records describe the joys and sorrows of the crew mates.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Tata"]={name="Gold Statuette: Tata", image="Gold Statuette Tata", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A miniature model of Tata. Thanks to the influences of the Valley's Aberrants, it is fully clad in heavy armor plates and furnished with 6 auto-turrets and 4 jet propulsion nozzles.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Qin Jiangchi"]={name="Gold Statuette: Qin Jiangchi", image="Gold Statuette Qin Jiangchi", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Qin Jiangchi. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. Her dazed and blank expression is extremely well done. A single glance could remind people how she looked when gazing upon the Power Plateau in the great distance.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Blighted Armorscale"]={name="Specimen: Blighted Armorscale", image="Specimen Blighted Armorscale", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A severely Blighted suit of armor sealed in a special jar. In some twisted aberrant, Rhodagn finally received a promise and inner peace. He took off his armor and led the Bonekrushers to the other end of the light. There, they would await their Baws's return.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Denstack Fragment"]={name="Specimen: Denstack Fragment", image="Specimen Denstack Fragment", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 1 green quality auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A special mini-denstack fragment created in some twisted aberrant and sealed away in a special jar. If the Bonekrushers were to forcibly replace Protocol-Originium with \"blessings\", they would be able to ride the flowing hazefyre itself.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 1 Green Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: Aburrey"]={name="Classified: Aburrey", image="Classified Aburrey", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the hero named Aburrey. Her students remembered all of her classes. Most importantly, they remembered her sacrifice, her fight, and her lesson for the future.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Package"},
	["Classified: Plan for Developing the Valleys"]={name="Classified: Plan for Developing the Valleys", image="Classified Plan for Developing the Valleys", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records of plans for developing various valleys. The entire project starts with Valley I, Valley II, Valley III, Valley IV, Valley V, and more beyond. If things work according to plan, these production sites would be part of a network linked with Talos City, and become a powerful arm that stretches to the North.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Chen Qianyu"]={name="Gold Statuette: Chen Qianyu", image="Gold Statuette Chen Qianyu", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Chen Qianyu. One could feel light, piercing tingles while holding it. The power of her swordmancy courses across the statuette's surface, perhaps influenced by the aberrant itself.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Mark"]={name="Gold Statuette: Mark", image="Gold Statuette Mark", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Mark holding a suppressant. The people's faith in the hero and his final will manifested the suppressant in this Protocol Space, time and time again.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Originium Branch"]={name="Specimen: Originium Branch", image="Specimen Originium Branch", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A fresh branch of the Great Originium Oak sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, someone grafted a withered twig of Seš'qamam witchcraft to the Great Originium Oak. This act caused the once-dead tree to sprout again with life.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Bombardment Beacon"]={name="Specimen: Bombardment Beacon", image="Specimen Bombardment Beacon", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 2 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="An orbital bombardment guidance beacon sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, Dijiang has enough heavy ordnance to bombard any location on the planet.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 2 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: The Pack"]={name="Classified: The Pack", image="Classified The Pack", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the Pack. It includes the history and development of the Pack — starting with the shattering of warlord Jakub's ambitions, the splintering of the Landbreaker clans, and to the present day.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Package"},
	["Classified: Aggelos Forge"]={name="Classified: Aggelos Forge", image="Classified Aggelos Forge", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the Aggelos Forge. The document seems to describe an aberrant version of some Originium Science Park experimental product. Artificial Aggeloi is a distant fantasy. Opening the forge only causes squealing pebbles to hop out of it.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Wulfgard"]={name="Gold Statuette: Wulfgard", image="Gold Statuette Wulfgard", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Wulfgard. One could feel scorching heat while holding it. A pack of wolves holding guns and ammo in their jaws circle around him.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Drill Crawler"]={name="Gold Statuette: Drill Crawler", image="Gold Statuette Drill Crawler", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A scale model so intricate that people might think someone actually shrunk the actual machine to make this. \"This old boy should've been the one to ram that blasted Ankhor open! This old boy is the REAL CHAMP!\" ...And it also comes with a text-to-speech module.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: DELTA Aggelos"]={name="Specimen: DELTA Aggelos", image="Specimen DELTA Aggelos", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A small artificial Aggelos controlled by an Imitation Ankhor. This was Andre's new invention in some twisted aberrant. Since then, the Aggeloi became reliable assistants.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Originium Formation"]={name="Specimen: Originium Formation", image="Specimen Originium Formation", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 3 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A dense Originium formation, the Endministrator's wrath left upon the land. In some twisted aberrant, the Endmin arrived a few days late and lost no memories.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 3 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: Giant Weaponry"]={name="Classified: Giant Weaponry", image="Classified Giant Weaponry", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about weapon stashes at a certain location. When the inglorious conflict ended, mass-casualty weapons were either destroyed or vaulted away. Of course, there were a few exceptions.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Package"},
	["Classified: Cathedral IV"]={name="Classified: Cathedral IV", image="Classified Cathedral IV", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the new cathedral of the Cabal of Tranquility. In some twisted aberrant, massive ruins hidden beneath the surface of Valley IV seized the attention of the Cabal. And thus they raised a new cathedral at that place.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Yvonne"]={name="Gold Statuette: Yvonne", image="Gold Statuette Yvonne", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Yvonne holding a vinyl between her fingers. The vinyl shares the same album cover that Yvonne showed you before, but the playlist sounds totally different. It felt as though the same musician has composed the music during a totally different time.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuettes: Collinses"]={name="Gold Statuettes: Collinses", image="Gold Statuettes Collinses", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Gold statuettes of the Collinses. Nobody knows why they showed up in the Protocol Space. The siblings have an entire arsenal of heavy weaponry behind them ... and give off a somber vibe representative of the UWST Security Bureau.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Tube Professor"]={name="Specimen: Tube Professor", image="Specimen Tube Professor", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A miniature tube professor sealed in a jar. It seems to have some resemblance to Pocus... And strangely enough, it is shaking wildly in its jar.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Astronomical Object"]={name="Specimen: Astronomical Object", image="Specimen Astronomical Object", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 4 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A fragment of an astronomical object sealed in a jar. Though ... the Fifth Child, the youngling, has fractured, it remains unblemished.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 4 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: Security Bureau Staff"]={name="Classified: Security Bureau Staff", image="Classified Security Bureau Staff", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about someone working in the UWST Security Bureau. The attached photograph looks extremely discomforting, as though someone took the features of different people and pieced them together to create a new face.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Package"},
	["Classified: Final Will"]={name="Classified: Final Will", image="Classified Final Will", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about several wills. The words on the letters kept changing: \"I never regretted joining the Security Bureau, baby sis...\" In some twisted aberrant, people failed to contain the disaster quickly enough. The words of the dead echo upon these pieces of paper.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Old Bombtail"]={name="Gold Statuette: Old Bombtail", image="Gold Statuette Old Bombtail", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of a Tweety-Bomb. This one seems to have been in service for a while, since it is covered in rust and looks pretty exhausted. If it could talk, it would have plenty of stories to tell.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Crowe"]={name="Gold Statuette: Crowe", image="Gold Statuette Crowe", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Crowe shrouded in hazefyre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. The face of the statuette is a twisted grimace of sadness, denial, and rage.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Arts Unit"]={name="Specimen: Arts Unit", image="Specimen Arts Unit", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="An experimental Arts Unit sealed in a jar. According to the ideas of the Originium Science Park designers, this liquid Arts Unit can attach itself to the surface of an Aggelos and exert control over it.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Blossom of Deathly Silence"]={name="Specimen: Blossom of Deathly Silence", image="Specimen Blossom of Deathly Silence", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 5 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A flower covered in dust sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, the Landbreakers completely occupied Valley IV for three hours before saturation bombardment turned the entire place into a lifeless ruin.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 5 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Classified: Rhodagn"]={name="Classified: Rhodagn", image="Classified Rhodagn", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about Rhodagn's life. They describe an actual past undistorted by the aberrant. Rhodagn fought battle after battle, crushed every contender with his heavy fists, and earned the right to bear the hazefyre generator upon his back.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Package"},
	["Classified: Bonekrusher Civil War"]={name="Classified: Bonekrusher Civil War", image="Classified Bonekrusher Civil War", tier=2, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 packages. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="Classified records about the Bonekrushers internal purge and the rise of Nefarith. They describe an actual past undistorted by the aberrant. Roarmaw, Old Witch, Hammersmith ... many tried to stop the rise of Nefarith. However, their weapons and even their bodies were cast into denstacks and have been burning ever since.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Package"},
	["Gold Statuette: Perlica"]={name="Gold Statuette: Perlica", image="Gold Statuette Perlica", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Perlica. It is exceptionally heavy for reasons unknown, though it might be an influence of the aberrant. The heavy responsibilities of the Supervisor are made manifest with this statuette.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Instrument Safe"},
	["Gold Statuette: Dijiang"]={name="Gold Statuette: Dijiang", image="Gold Statuette Dijiang", tier=3, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 instrument safes. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A gold statuette of Dijiang. A small shard of Origocrust replaced the Protocol-Originium of the original. It is aligned vertically to point straight at the sky, and symbolizes the indomitable spirit of humanity.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Instrument Safe"},
	["Specimen: Bonekrusher Dolls"]={name="Specimen: Bonekrusher Dolls", image="Specimen Bonekrusher Dolls", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="A number of dolls sealed in a jar. They have been pierced through and bound together by a rusty wire. Vanguards, pyromancers, executioners ... bloodied, maimed, and screaming, all are tied together to create a tower of bodies.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Auto-Vendor"},
	["Specimen: Blood Dust"]={name="Specimen: Blood Dust", image="Specimen Blood Dust", tier=4, use="Acquired from Aberrant Zone 6 auto-vendors. Can be submitted to complete commissions.", desc="The blood of the great nemesis sealed in a jar. The fluid has already seeped into the earth. This is but a warped and superficial fantasy. She walked into the light as humanity had long bled dry.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Drop: Aberrant Zone 6 Auto-Vendor"},

	["Portable Explosives Chip 2"]={name="Portable Explosives Chip 2", image="Portable Explosives Chip", link="Portable Explosives Chip", tier=5, use="Allows the user to bring more Industrial Explosives into the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Portable Explosives\" technology. 	["Nodule Refining Chip 1"]={name="Nodule Refining Chip 1", image="Nodule Refining Chip", link="Nodule Refining Chip", tier=5, use="Precipitation nodules successfully brought out can be converted into more Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Nodule Refining\" technology. \"These precipitation nodules are... well... kinda like fowlbeast eggs at different stages of development. 	["Nodule Refining Chip 2"]={name="Nodule Refining Chip 2", image="Nodule Refining Chip", link="Nodule Refining Chip", tier=5, use="Precipitation nodules successfully brought out can be converted into more Aurylene Crystals.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Nodule Refining\" technology. \"These precipitation nodules are... well... kinda like fowlbeast eggs at different stages of development. 	["Fragmented Treatment Chip"]={name="Fragmented Treatment Chip", tier=5, use="Restores HP to the teammate with the lowest health by defeating enemies in the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Fragmented Treatment\" technology. Though subject to interference exerted by ambient Derangement, it will do its best to keep you alive and safeguard your health.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Tactical Tempo Chip"]={name="Tactical Tempo Chip", tier=5, use="Recover SP by defeating enemies in the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Tactical Tempo\" technology. \"Use their energy against themselves to avoid exhausting yourself!\" Lil' Dodge certainly knows how to translate Mr. Krad's lessons into short, simple phrases.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Armor Gilding Chip"]={name="Armor Gilding Chip", tier=5, use="Operators enjoy higher Max HP in the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Armor Gilding\" technology. Applying a precipitation nodule coating on the armor can effectively defend against the threat posed by the Protocol Space.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Charge Burst Chip"]={name="Charge Burst Chip", tier=5, use="The first skill cast after start of every battle deals more DMG in Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Charge Burst\" technology. \"This is quite a dangerous test. 	["Energy Capture Chip"]={name="Energy Capture Chip", tier=5, use="Grants Ultimate Energy by defeating enemies in the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Energy Capture\" technology. 	["Stress Feedback Chip"]={name="Stress Feedback Chip", tier=5, use="Grants faster SP Recovery in the Valley's Aberrants.", desc="A chip storing data related to the \"Stress Feedback\" technology. Perhaps one day will come when we finally make enough progress in Aberrant-interference technologies, giving us better \"feedback\" from these twisted Protocol Spaces.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
